check_connection.title: Check the connection
check_connection.description: List the organization's campaigns, the connector's own verification call. The cheapest request that proves the API key still works; use list_campaigns for real campaign lookups with filters.

take.description: How many campaigns to return (1-50).

TotalFiltered.description: Records matching the filters; page with skip/take until skip reaches this.

Start.description: 0-based index of the first record on this page.

get_database.title: Get organization info
get_database.description: Read general information about the Bloomerang database (organization) this API key belongs to: name, id and settings. Use get_current_user for the user behind the key.

get_current_user.title: Get the current user
get_current_user.description: Read the Bloomerang user that owns the private API key in use: id, name, email and role. Use the id as a task assignee.

list_constituents.title: List constituents
list_constituents.description: Page through individual and organization constituents, optionally filtered by id, type, last-modified date, favourite flag or a custom field value, and sorted. For free-text name/email lookup use search_constituents; to check for an existing record before creating one use find_duplicate_constituents.

skip.description: How many records to skip before the page starts (0-based offset).

take.description: How many records to return (1-50, default 50).

last_modified.description: Only constituents modified after this ISO 8601 date/time.

is_favorite.description: Only constituents the API user has favourited.

ids.description: Only these constituent ids, pipe-separated, e.g. 101|102.

custom_field_id.description: Filter on this custom field id (use with custom_field_value).

custom_field_value.description: Value the custom field must have.

TotalFiltered.description: Records matching the filters; page with skip/take until skip reaches this.

Start.description: 0-based index of the first record on this page.

Results.description: Constituent records with names, primary contact details and custom values.

search_constituents.title: Search constituents
search_constituents.description: Free-text search across constituents and households by name, email, phone or address, the way the Bloomerang search box works. Returns matching constituent and household summaries; use get_constituent for the full record.

search.description: Text to search for, e.g. a name or email address.

skip.description: How many records to skip before the page starts (0-based offset).

take.description: How many records to return (1-50, default 50).

Results.description: Constituent and household records.

get_constituent.title: Get a constituent
get_constituent.description: Read one constituent by API id: names, status, primary and secondary addresses, emails and phones, household, communication settings and custom values.

id.description: The constituent's API ID (not the account/transaction number shown in the UI).

create_constituent.title: Create a constituent
create_constituent.description: Create an individual or organization constituent with an optional primary email, phone and address and custom values. Always creates a new record; to avoid duplicates call find_duplicate_constituents first, or use upsert_constituent to merge into an existing match.

type.description: Individual or Organization. Individuals need first_name and last_name; organizations need full_name.

full_name.description: Organization name, or an override of an individual's full name.

prefix.description: Prefix such as Mr. or Dr.; must match a prefix configured in Bloomerang.

suffix.description: Suffix such as Jr.; must match a suffix configured in Bloomerang.

informal_name.description: Informal name used in letters, e.g. 'Ada'.

phone.description: Primary phone number, formatted, without extension.

state.description: Primary address state/province; must match one configured in Bloomerang.

custom_values.description: Custom field values to set. Each item is {FieldId, Value} for a free-text field, {FieldId, ValueId} for a single pick field, or {FieldId, ValueIds: [..]} for a multi-pick field. Look up fields with list_custom_fields and pick values with list_custom_field_values.

household_id.description: Household to add the constituent to.

email_interest_type.description: Email subscription: All, Custom (with custom_email_interest_ids) or OptedOut.

custom_email_interest_ids.description: Email interest ids when email_interest_type is Custom (see list_email_interests).

output.description: The created constituent, including its new Id.

update_constituent.title: Update a constituent
update_constituent.description: Change fields on an existing constituent; only the fields you pass are sent. Supplying email, phone or address replaces the primary one. Use update_constituent_communication_settings for opt-outs and preferred channel, and the address/email/phone tools for secondary contact details.

id.description: The constituent's API ID (not the account/transaction number shown in the UI).

full_name.description: Organization name, or an override of an individual's full name.

prefix.description: Prefix such as Mr. or Dr.; must match a prefix configured in Bloomerang.

suffix.description: Suffix such as Jr.; must match a suffix configured in Bloomerang.

custom_values.description: Custom field values to set. Each item is {FieldId, Value} for a free-text field, {FieldId, ValueId} for a single pick field, or {FieldId, ValueIds: [..]} for a multi-pick field. Look up fields with list_custom_fields and pick values with list_custom_field_values.

delete_constituent.title: Delete a constituent
delete_constituent.description: Permanently delete a constituent and the records attached to it. Cannot be undone; consider update_constituent with status Inactive instead.

id.description: The constituent's API ID (not the account/transaction number shown in the UI).

find_duplicate_constituents.title: Find duplicate constituents
find_duplicate_constituents.description: Check whether a person or organization already exists before creating it. A match needs a name plus one piece of contact info: first_name and last_name (or organization_name) and at least one of street, phone_number or email_address. Returns candidate constituents; empty means no duplicate.

upsert_constituent.title: Create or merge a constituent
upsert_constituent.description: Create a constituent, or merge the supplied data into an existing one if Bloomerang finds a duplicate (name plus one of address, email or phone). The safest way to record a person from a form or import without creating duplicates. Returns the resulting constituent.

get_transaction.title: Get a transaction
get_transaction.description: Read one transaction with its payment details and every designation (donation, pledge, pledge payment, recurring donation or payment).

id.description: The transaction's API ID (not the account/transaction number shown in the UI).

create_transaction.title: Create a transaction
create_transaction.description: Record a donation, pledge, pledge payment, recurring-donation schedule or recurring payment for a constituent. The payment is only charged when wallet_item_id is supplied; otherwise the gift is just recorded. Fields required depend on method: Check needs check_number, InKind needs in_kind_description.
create_transaction.notes: Destructive because supplying wallet_item_id charges the donor's saved payment method.

amount.description: Total amount; must equal the sum of the designations.

method.description: Payment method. Use None for a pledge or recurring-donation schedule with no payment yet.

designations.description: Designations splitting the amount; their Amounts must sum to amount. Each is an object with Type (Donation, Pledge, PledgePayment, RecurringDonation or RecurringDonationPayment), Amount, FundId (required for Donation, Pledge, RecurringDonation), optional CampaignId, AppealId, TributeId, Note, NonDeductibleAmount, AcknowledgementStatus (Yes/No/DoNotAcknowledge), CustomValues and SoftCredits ([{AccountId, Amount}]). A Pledge also needs PledgeFrequency and PledgeInstallments ([{Date, Amount}], see generate_pledge_installments); a PledgePayment needs PledgeId; a RecurringDonation needs RecurringDonationFrequency and RecurringDonationStartDate (optional RecurringDonationEndDate, RecurringDonationDay1/Day2); a RecurringDonationPayment needs RecurringDonationId and IsExtraPayment.

check_number.description: Check number (required when method is Check).

in_kind_description.description: What was given (required when method is InKind).

in_kind_market_value.description: Fair market value of the in-kind gift.

wallet_item_id.description: Saved card or bank account to charge (see list_wallet_items). Supplying it makes Bloomerang actually charge the payment.

credit_card_type.description: Card brand for a card payment recorded without charging.

credit_card_last_four.description: Last four digits of the card.

eft_account_type.description: Bank account type for an EFT payment.

eft_last_four.description: Last four digits of the bank account.

integration_url.description: Link to the transaction in a third-party system.

entry_method.description: How the payment was entered (EntryMethod header).

method_origin.description: Application the transaction came from (MethodOrigin header).

output.description: The created transaction with its designations.

update_transaction.title: Update a transaction
update_transaction.description: Change an existing transaction's date, amount, method, payment details or designations. Bloomerang validates the whole record, so send the designations with their Ids when changing amounts.

id.description: The transaction's API ID (not the account/transaction number shown in the UI).

amount.description: Total amount; must equal the sum of the designations.

method.description: Payment method. Use None for a pledge or recurring-donation schedule with no payment yet.

Each is an object with Type (Donation, Pledge, PledgePayment, RecurringDonation or RecurringDonationPayment), Amount, FundId (required for Donation, Pledge, RecurringDonation), optional CampaignId, AppealId, TributeId, Note, NonDeductibleAmount, AcknowledgementStatus (Yes/No/DoNotAcknowledge), CustomValues and SoftCredits ([{AccountId, Amount}]). A Pledge also needs PledgeFrequency and PledgeInstallments ([{Date, Amount}], see generate_pledge_installments); a PledgePayment needs PledgeId; a RecurringDonation needs RecurringDonationFrequency and RecurringDonationStartDate (optional RecurringDonationEndDate, RecurringDonationDay1/Day2); a RecurringDonationPayment needs RecurringDonationId and IsExtraPayment.

eft_account_type.description: Bank account type for an EFT payment.

eft_last_four.description: Last four digits of the bank account.

entry_method.description: How the payment was entered (EntryMethod header).

take.description: How many records to return (1-50, default 50).

last_modified.description: Only refunds modified after this ISO 8601 date.

transaction_ids.description: Only refunds of these transaction ids, pipe-separated.

TotalFiltered.description: Records matching the filters; page with skip/take until skip reaches this.

Start.description: 0-based index of the first record on this page.

Results.description: Refunds with TransactionId, Date, Amount and Note.

get_refund.title: Get a refund
get_refund.description: Read one refund by id, with its transaction, date, amount and reason.

id.description: The refund's API ID (not the account/transaction number shown in the UI).

create_refund.title: Refund a transaction
create_refund.description: Refund a transaction in the CRM, and optionally at the payment processor too (run_processor_refund), which returns money to the donor.

run_processor_refund.description: Also refund through the payment processor (true), or only record it in the CRM (false).

update_refund.title: Update a refund
update_refund.description: Change the date, transaction or note of a recorded refund.

id.description: The refund's API ID (not the account/transaction number shown in the UI).

delete_refund.title: Delete a refund
delete_refund.description: Delete a refund record from the CRM. Does not reverse a refund already made at the payment processor.

id.description: The refund's API ID (not the account/transaction number shown in the UI).

list_wallet_items.title: List wallet items
list_wallet_items.description: List saved payment methods (tokenized cards and bank accounts) for constituents; pass an id as wallet_item_id to create_transaction to charge it.

skip.description: How many records to skip before the page starts (0-based offset).

take.description: How many records to return (1-50, default 50).

require_active_processor.description: Only items whose processor is active.

type.description: Only this kind of payment method.

constituent_ids.description: Only items of these constituent ids, pipe-separated.

ids.description: Only these wallet item ids, pipe-separated.

TotalFiltered.description: Records matching the filters; page with skip/take until skip reaches this.

Start.description: 0-based index of the first record on this page.

Results.description: Wallet items with type, last four digits and processor.

get_wallet_item.title: Get a wallet item
get_wallet_item.description: Read one saved payment method (tokenized card or bank account) by id, with its type and last four digits.

id.description: The wallet item's API ID (not the account/transaction number shown in the UI).

create_wallet_item.title: Save a payment method
create_wallet_item.description: Store a tokenized card or bank account for a constituent. The token must come from the processor (or Spreedly); raw card numbers are never accepted.

account_id.description: Constituent the payment method belongs to.

is_spreedly_token.description: Whether the token is a Spreedly token.

eft_account_last_four.description: Last four digits of the bank account (required for Eft).

delete_wallet_item.title: Delete a wallet item
delete_wallet_item.description: Remove a saved payment method from a constituent.

id.description: The wallet item's API ID (not the account/transaction number shown in the UI).

list_processors.title: List processors
list_processors.description: List the payment processor accounts configured in Bloomerang, whose ids create_wallet_item takes.

skip.description: How many records to skip before the page starts (0-based offset).

take.description: How many records to return (1-50, default 50).

TotalFiltered.description: Records matching the filters; page with skip/take until skip reaches this.

Start.description: 0-based index of the first record on this page.

Results.description: Processor accounts.

get_processor.title: Get a processor
get_processor.description: Read one payment processor account by id.

id.description: The processor's API ID (not the account/transaction number shown in the UI).

list_interactions.title: List interactions
list_interactions.description: Page through logged interactions (calls, emails, meetings, letters) with constituents, filtered by constituent, channel or purpose.

take.description: How many records to return (1-50, default 50).

purposes.description: Only these purposes, pipe-separated, e.g. Solicitation|Acknowledgement.

get_interaction.title: Get an interaction
get_interaction.description: Read one logged interaction by id: constituent, date, channel, purpose, subject, note and custom values.

id.description: The interaction's API ID (not the account/transaction number shown in the UI).

create_interaction.title: Log an interaction
create_interaction.description: Record a call, email, meeting or other touchpoint with a constituent on their timeline. For a follow-up to do later use create_task; for a free-form remark use create_note.

is_inbound.description: True if the constituent reached out.

custom_values.description: Custom field values to set. Each item is {FieldId, Value} for a free-text field, {FieldId, ValueId} for a single pick field, or {FieldId, ValueIds: [..]} for a multi-pick field. Look up fields with list_custom_fields and pick values with list_custom_field_values.

update_interaction.title: Update an interaction
update_interaction.description: Change the date, channel, purpose, subject, note or custom values of a logged interaction.

id.description: The interaction's API ID (not the account/transaction number shown in the UI).

is_inbound.description: True if the constituent reached out.

custom_values.description: Custom field values to set. Each item is {FieldId, Value} for a free-text field, {FieldId, ValueId} for a single pick field, or {FieldId, ValueIds: [..]} for a multi-pick field. Look up fields with list_custom_fields and pick values with list_custom_field_values.

id.description: The interaction's API ID (not the account/transaction number shown in the UI).

create_note.description: Add a free-form note to a constituent's record. Use create_interaction for an actual touchpoint.

custom_values.description: Custom field values to set. Each item is {FieldId, Value} for a free-text field, {FieldId, ValueId} for a single pick field, or {FieldId, ValueIds: [..]} for a multi-pick field. Look up fields with list_custom_fields and pick values with list_custom_field_values.

update_note.title: Update a note
update_note.description: Change the text, date, constituent or custom values of a note.

id.description: The note's API ID (not the account/transaction number shown in the UI).

custom_values.description: Custom field values to set. Each item is {FieldId, Value} for a free-text field, {FieldId, ValueId} for a single pick field, or {FieldId, ValueIds: [..]} for a multi-pick field. Look up fields with list_custom_fields and pick values with list_custom_field_values.

delete_note.title: Delete a note
delete_note.description: Permanently delete a note from a constituent's record. Cannot be undone.

id.description: The note's API ID (not the account/transaction number shown in the UI).

list_tasks.title: List tasks
list_tasks.description: Page through tasks (follow-ups assigned to users), filtered by status, due-date range, assignee, constituent, channel or purpose.

take.description: How many records to return (1-50, default 50).

get_task.description: Read one task by id: due date, subject, assignee, constituent and status.

create_task.description: Create a follow-up task for a user, optionally about a constituent, and optionally email the assignee.

user_id.description: User the task is assigned to (see get_current_user).

send_notifications.description: Email the assignee about the task.

update_task.title: Update a task
update_task.description: Change a task's due date, subject, note, channel, purpose, assignee or constituent. Use complete_task to close it.

id.description: The task's API ID (not the account/transaction number shown in the UI).

user_id.description: User the task is assigned to (see get_current_user).

send_notifications.description: Email the assignee about the task.

complete_task.title: Complete a task
complete_task.description: Mark a task complete, optionally turning it into an interaction on the constituent's timeline.

id.description: The task's API ID (not the account/transaction number shown in the UI).

save_as_interaction.description: Also log it as an interaction (the task must have a constituent).

delete_task.title: Delete a task
delete_task.description: Permanently delete a task. Use complete_task instead to close a finished one.

id.description: The task's API ID (not the account/transaction number shown in the UI).
